name: Adversarial Attack on GeNeRF
aliases: Targeted Adversarial Attack on Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A targeted adversarial attack method for Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields (GeNeRFs) that modifies source images (views) to force the rendered output to match a manually created 'adversarial ground truth' image containing hallucinated objects, deleted objects, or modified shapes.
summary: This targeted attack modifies multiple source views to force GeNeRF outputs to match a manual target, using residual loss to preserve image quality in unmodified regions.
